evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: The headline gains are established by ground-truth-labeled downstream benchmarks and simulator-based policy evaluations, which do not depend on the foundation model used for feature extraction or on the coverage/fidelity scores used to choose selection axes.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Downstream task metrics (classification accuracy, mIoU, RMSE, EPDMS, LIBERO success rate) computed from independently trained task models on held-out evaluation splits.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: The selection axes (mu12, sigma12, delta_max) are chosen by correlating coreset-level coverage and fidelity scores against downstream performance across 5,265 historical training runs, and the selection procedure itself is tuned via ablations on CIFAR10 downstream accuracy.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Reported performance metrics directly align with the claims: CoreDNA matches or outperforms baselines across diverse perception and action benchmarks, demonstrating robustness to redundancy and practical utility without task-specific tuning or labels.
primary.evaluation_assessment: The evaluation spans multiple tasks (image classification, semantic segmentation, metric depth estimation, and imitation learning for driving and manipulation) across seven benchmarks and compares CoreDNA against nine training-based and training-free baselines across multiple retention ratios with three seeds.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Final model performance is measured via ground-truth task labels and benchmark metrics on held-out evaluation splits completely independent of the feature extraction model.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Objective downstream task test metrics (classification accuracy, mIoU, RMSE, NAVSIM EPDMS, and LIBERO success rate) from independently trained task models.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Foundation model neuron activation histogram statistics pooled relative to the full dataset distribution.

primary.limitations: The authors openly address that optimal sampling strategies (fidelity vs. coverage) vary depending on dataset tail characteristics, and note that fixed retention ratios or redundant modalities (e.g., manipulation proprioception) do not uniformly improve performance.
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is thoroughly detailed, describing per-neuron Earth Mover's Distance extraction relative to the dataset, layerwise statistic pooling into a compact representation space, and concrete selection algorithms (sliced Wasserstein minimization and FPS) with explicit pseudo-code and parameter settings.
primary.quality_rationale: The work provides a well-motivated, scalable solution to label-free coreset selection backed by rigorous empirical analysis of activation distributions across 5,265 historical runs, clear algorithmic formulations, and comprehensive downstream cross-domain evaluations.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper introduces CoreDNA, an unsupervised and task-agnostic coreset selection method that summarizes multi-layer foundation model activation histograms relative to full-dataset distributions, selecting data subsets using sliced Wasserstein distance or farthest-point sampling.

scholarly_quality.rationale: The work provides a well-motivated, scalable solution to label-free coreset selection backed by rigorous empirical analysis of activation distributions across 5,265 historical runs, clear algorithmic formulations, and comprehensive downstream cross-domain evaluations.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors openly address that optimal sampling strategies (fidelity vs. coverage) vary depending on dataset tail characteristics, and note that fixed retention ratios or redundant modalities (e.g., manipulation proprioception) do not uniformly improve performance.
